project: Namias Portfolio - System Audit & Fix Plan
summary: Complete system audit findings and fix plan. 45 issues identified across critical, high, medium, and low severity. Fixes organized into 10 commit slices targeting react-doctor score improvement from 59/100 to 100/100, fixing 3 critical bugs, eliminating code duplication, and improving accessibility.

auditResults.codeAudit: 45 issues found (3 critical, 6 high, 16 medium, 20 low)

security.details: Build pipeline runs code near secrets (3x CI workflows)

bugs.details: fetch in useEffect (1 error), time/random in JSX (1), button missing type (6x)

accessibility.details: Interactive not focusable (1), role instead of tag (1), mouse handler missing focus (1)

criticalIssues.title: JSX Structural Misplacement in ProjectDetailPage
criticalIssues.description: A <JsonLd> component is incorrectly nested inside a gallery image wrapper div. This creates invalid DOM nesting — a <script> tag rendered inside a CSS grid cell. Causes React hydration warnings and visually broken gallery items.
criticalIssues.fix: Move the <JsonLd> component outside the gallery item div to be a sibling of the top-level fragment.

criticalIssues.title: GROQ Query Injection in blog-sync.mjs
criticalIssues.description: frontmatter.slug is interpolated directly into a GROQ query string. If a slug contains double-quotes or GROQ-special characters, it could break the query or allow injection.
criticalIssues.fix: Sanitize slug values or use GROQ parameterized queries with double-star escaping.

criticalIssues.title: Mutable Module-Level State in md-to-portable-text.ts
criticalIssues.description: let keyCounter = 0 is module-level mutable state. In parallel tests or long-running processes, keys are not deterministic and could collide.
criticalIssues.fix: Use a function-scoped counter or crypto.randomUUID() for key generation.

highIssues.title: Duplicate Portable Text Converters (5+ copies)
highIssues.description: The same conversion logic exists in 5+ places. Inline versions in blog-sync.mjs and import-sanity-posts.mjs are simplified and lose data (lists, code blocks, blockquotes, inline formatting).
highIssues.fix: Import from scripts/lib/ in all scripts. Remove inline duplicates.

highIssues.title: Missing Button Type Attributes (6 instances)
highIssues.description: Buttons without explicit type attribute default to submit, which can accidentally submit forms.
highIssues.fix: Add type='button' to all non-submit buttons.

highIssues.title: blog-sync.mjs args Referenced via Closure
highIssues.description: cmdPull and cmdPush reference module-level args variable via closure rather than receiving it as a parameter. Makes functions impure and untestable.
highIssues.fix: Pass args as a parameter to each command function.

highIssues.title: import-sanity-posts.mjs Incorrect Status Logic
highIssues.description: Status check uses fs.existsSync after writing, so it always returns 'updated' when FORCE is true even on first write.
highIssues.fix: Check existence before writing, not after.

highIssues.title: ConnectSection Nested <section> Without Accessible Name
highIssues.description: Outer <section> has aria-labelledby but heading is inside inner section. Screen readers announce a section with no direct heading.
highIssues.fix: Remove redundant outer <section> or move heading to be direct child.

highIssues.title: 3d-card.tsx useEffect Missing Dependency + Direct DOM Manipulation
highIssues.description: useEffect suppresses exhaustive-deps warning. handleAnimations closure captures stale props. Direct style.transform mutation bypasses React.
highIssues.fix: Refactor to use proper dependency array or move animation logic to a custom hook.

commitPlan.strategy: One commit per fix slice. Each commit passes tsc, lint, and vitest.

slices.title: Final verification and PRD update

openQuestions.question: Should we fix the CI workflow security warnings (build pipeline secret boundary)?
openQuestions.answer: No — these are CI configuration warnings that require changes to GitHub Actions workflows, not application code. They are low-risk for a portfolio site.

openQuestions.question: Should we remove styled-components from package.json?
openQuestions.answer: Yes — it appears unused. Will verify with a grep before removing.

openQuestions.question: Should we upgrade tsconfig target from ES2017 to ES2022?
openQuestions.answer: No — this is a configuration change that could affect build output. Defer to a separate PR.
